div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
跨国药企新药 MoA / 植介入器械演示 / 医院患者知情同意视频
(需通过严苛 MLR 医学法规审查与 FDA Fair-Balance 门禁)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 视频生成与合成架构选择？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
解剖与受体构象准确率仅 31.5% (5心室/支架融化)
风险提示文字乱码，药企 MLR 审查 0% 通过

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
单支 90s 视频耗资 $65,000 且排期 14 周
法务改一句风险词需耗时数周重新渲染

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 1: 导入 RCSB PDB 晶体 / DICOM 器官 / STEP 器械网格
导出逐帧精确 Depth + Normal + 部件分割掩码

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 2: 受控神经次表面散射 (SSS) 着色
99.8% 锁死分子/解剖结构并渲染电影级细胞膜光影

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 3: Remotion 确定性合成 FDA Fair-Balance 35% 警示坞
风险播报期背景运镜自动降速 80% + 临床数据零幻觉

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 4: 6 年级通俗可读性转写 + 17 语种音素同步
99.5% MLR 一次过审 · $14.50/支 (省 99.98%)
